summary: Build an executive AI portfolio, governance approach, and value roadmap. Explore the five-day training outline and assess fit for your leadership team.
lede: AI transformation training helps senior leaders prioritize AI investments and oversee initiatives against business outcomes. Participants assess use cases with value, feasibility, risk, and readiness criteria, examine data readiness, and define ownership and oversight decisions. Workshops practise building investment scorecards, mapping risk and escalation responsibilities, and shaping a roadmap and benefits dashboard.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior professionals who sponsor, fund, govern, or oversee AI initiatives and need a practical executive view of portfolio choices and accountability.
modules: AI Operating Model and Value Reviews
prerequisites: Prior experience in an executive, senior functional, digital, data, risk, or transformation role is expected. Familiarity with organizational investment decisions and business performance measures will help you apply the course scenarios. No coding or model-building experience is required.
